name: Lekker Design Studio and Work Archive
description: A proof-first studio website and work archive documented from the shipped implementation.

font.fallback: Helvetica Neue, Arial, PingFang HK, Microsoft JhengHei, sans-serif

contentTruth.projectSource: The project catalog in Lekker.Design/portfolio.js and locally captured screenshots from the linked public sites.
contentTruth.curation: The six selected projects are reversible editorial curation, not a performance ranking.

responsive.desktop: Homepage Proof Collision hero and asymmetric three-build field; portfolio two-column hero, 12-column selected-work field, sticky approach statement, and two-column archive above 1080px.
responsive.tablet: Homepage proof pair remains opposed while work and process stack; portfolio hero becomes one column below 820px; both pages use the mobile menu.
responsive.mobile: Homepage keeps a two-line proposition and paired hero proofs, then uses one-column work, disciplines, process, and archive preview. Portfolio uses one selected-work column, 4:3 media, 112px archive thumbnails, and a horizontal filter row below 560px.

motion.hero: Portfolio uses a four-shot staggered clip reveal; homepage uses two opposed clip reveals followed by the orange studio mark.
motion.scroll: IntersectionObserver reveals opacity, translateY, and blur once.
motion.hover: Project images scale between 1.018 and 1.035; buttons translate 1px to 2px.
motion.reducedMotion: Animations, transforms, filters, smooth scroll, and transitions collapse to immediate states.

accessibility.navigation: Skip link, semantic landmarks, sticky desktop navigation, labeled mobile menu.
accessibility.state: aria-expanded for the menu, aria-pressed for filters, and a polite live region for archive counts.
accessibility.media: Selected work has localized alt text; duplicate archive thumbnails are decorative and untabbable.
accessibility.preferences: Reduced motion and reduced transparency are supported.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.description: Sticky three-zone navigation with language persistence and a responsive menu.

components.name: WorkDisciplineNav

components.name: SelectedWork

components.name: ArchiveFilters
